items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Isidore Fritz was one of the greatest clarinetists we had. Jazz kinder. He was nothing but a jazz kinder.

ctx.x: Well, as I change the subject while I think of it, across the lake I'm wondering about the music there, since most people over here don't know it. Do you remember Isidore Fritz?

Isidore Fritz was one of the greatest clarinetists we had. Jazz kinder. He was nothing but a jazz kinder. He didn't read no music. And he could play anything you play and put harmony to anything you know.
I know George Lewis talks about him being wonderful. I wonder if anybody else ever heard him.
